job_spec.name: dsfd_coll_ct-fe-6d1a3decb-kpslvt-tc-cl
job_spec.purpose: hardcore-1010 collct (dual-track -cl fe): ct = PS=1 + RSL=8 + KPS. Root cause of rslps routed TT -56.65 / FF -6.17 (reg->reg TT +171.8, inputs +91.7; ONLY 4 output ports fail): opt_merge folded the issued-credit pin station icr_q and the valid pin station ov_q (both = send 2 cycles late) into ONE flop u_lo7.o_v driving lo7_r (S face) and elo_v (E face); same for li7, li3, lo3. The anchor can sit at only one pin -> 9-level buffered wire to the other (SS -139). Fix: every 1-bit station and the RSL credit/valid flops are separate keep_hierarchy instances (ot_s81ph_keep_ff; a plain (* keep *) reg does not stop opt_merge) + SYNTH_KEEP_MODULES. 0 cycles. HM 0.010 for the id_q->d_q FF -6.17 reg->reg hold. LVT variant (OT_MULTI_VT=lvt, VT swap in repair_timing) on the same RTL.
